issues.detail: The code handles rate limiting but does not cover quota_exceeded or insufficient_credit errors, leaving some error scenarios unhandled.
The skill file contains extensive explanatory text that may be considered verbose beyond necessary instructions.
The skill is implemented in Python and relies on specific libraries, limiting its applicability to agents that support Python execution.
